request.prompt:
A working district in Halyard where fabrication, water research, advanced materials, and industrial ownership visibly meet. The image should show a prosperous but institutionally controlled innovation environment rather than a generic futuristic laboratory.

Must be shown, exactly as written: The future should look like retrofit and ordinary use: advanced systems are integrated into industrial buildings and working districts rather than presented as miraculous or ornamental technology. `(world.md; rules/hard-sf-rules.md)`

Not established, so your choice: The image may show a modular water unit with membranes, pretreatment, microbial or biofilter components, mineral-recovery equipment, and serviceable parts, but no exact technical geometry is established.

Must not appear: Do not make every worker visually identical or reduce the district to autonomous machines without human maintenance and judgment. `(world.md; rules/decisions.md)`

No lettering of any kind: no captions, labels, signage, logos, numbers, speech balloons or on-screen text, unless the brief requires a specific one. Concept reference, not finished comic art; no panel borders.

Add nothing that tells a story of its own: no invented symbols, emblems, documents or events. Render the description, not an interpretation of it.
